features.name: Singleton
features.description: Registers three singleton services and resolves each of them repeatedly. Every resolve of the same service must return the same instance.

features.name: Transient
features.description: Registers three transient services and resolves each of them repeatedly. Every resolve must create a new instance, never reusing an earlier one.

features.name: PerResolve
features.description: Resolves an object graph that asks for the same dependency twice. Both requests inside one resolution share an instance, while the next resolution gets a new one.

features.name: Scoped
features.description: Resolves scoped services inside explicit scopes. One instance per scope, different instances across scopes, and scope-owned disposables are disposed when the scope ends.

features.name: Combined
features.description: Resolves three roots that mix singleton and transient dependencies. The singleton is shared across every root while each transient dependency is distinct.

features.name: Complex
features.description: Registers and resolves three multi-level object graphs, checking that every nested dependency has the expected implementation type and lifetime.

features.name: Property
features.description: Resolves three roots that carry writable service properties. The container, or its intended property-injection extension, must assign them during activation.

features.name: Generics
features.description: Registers one open generic service mapping and resolves roots closed over int, float and object. Registering every closed type separately does not count.

features.name: IEnumerable
features.description: Injects a sequence of five plugin implementations and requires it to be genuinely lazy: nothing is created until enumeration, and every enumeration yields new transients.

features.name: Array
features.description: Resolves three roots that materialise their injected sequence of five plugins into an array while the root is being activated.

features.name: Conditional
features.description: Gives each of three consumers a different implementation of one contract, chosen through the metadata, key, predicate or consumer-context mechanism of the library.

features.name: Child Container
features.description: Creates a real nested child container that inherits the registrations of its parent and can add or override them without changing the parent.

features.name: Interception With Proxy
features.description: Resolves a service through the interception or activation extension point of the library. The result must be a proxy whose interceptor proceeds to the real target.

features.name: Prepare And Register
features.description: Measures creating the container and registering the whole prescribed graph, without resolving anything from it.

features.name: Prepare And Register And Simple Resolve
features.description: Measures the same setup as Prepare And Register, followed by a single resolve of one singleton root.
